research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TileGreen is researching and developing a thermomechanical process for recycling and treating plastic waste, flexible laminated packaging waste, and mineral aggregates, as described in 'A thermomechanical process for recycling plastic waste, flexible laminated…'. The process involves pre-processing, processing, and post-processing stages to produce durable building materials. These activities focus on transforming unrecyclable plastic waste into usable construction products.

overview_description.description: TileGreen is a manufacturing technology company that invented a patented, machine-learning-based, and automated thermomechanical modular technology (TG1.0) that acts as a platform for producing more than 100 circular, economic, and durable building materials (recycled-polymer-aggregate-composite) from all types of mechanically unrecyclable plastic waste at a green discount, not a green premium. Re-PAC material doesn’t crack, rot, rust, erode, or interact with chemicals, which makes it a durable, economical, and green alternative for multiple concrete, clay, wood, and metal non-structural applications.
